definitions.explanation: Indicates the number of floors in a building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一戸建|いっこだ}て→一戸建て：19687_ikkodate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いたい→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I want to buy a detached house.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五階建|ごかいだ}て→五階建て：28474_gokaidate⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{二階建|にかいだ}て→二階建て：03001_nikaidate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a two-story house.

notes:
〜{建|だ}て is a suffix indicating the number of floors or type of building structure.

PRONUNCIATION:
Usually read as だて, sometimes たて.

COMMON USES (number of floors):
- ⟦{二階建|にかいだ}て→二階建て：03001_nikaidate⟧: two-story
- ⟦{三階建|さんがいだ}て→三階建て：26640_sangaidate⟧: three-story
- ⟦{五階建|ごかいだ}て→五階建て：28474_gokaidate⟧: five-story
- ⟦{高層建|こうそうだ}て→高層建て：28655_kousoudate⟧: high-rise
- ⟦{平屋建|ひらやだ}て→平屋建て：28473_hirayadate⟧: single-story

BUILDING TYPES:
- ⟦{一戸建|いっこだ}て→一戸建て：19687_ikkodate⟧: detached house
- ⟦{木造建|もくぞうだ}て→木造建て：noentry⟧: wooden building
- ⟦{鉄骨建|てっこつだ}て→鉄骨建て：noentry⟧: steel-frame building

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Used as noun modifier: ⟦{二階建|にかいだ}て→二階建て：03001_nikaidate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ (two-story house)
- Used predicatively: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五階建|ごかいだ}て→五階建て：28474_gokaidate⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧

RELATED VERB: ⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ (to build).
